tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ zhes sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par gyur ces dang so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra ni wi ti hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkham̐ ram̐ mahā arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda'i bar dang*/ mthar rdo rje snying gar bzung*/ dril bu rgyun dkrol dang rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol bya ste/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pā ra mi ta/ nā da swa bhā we badzra dharma hṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// mchod pa rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/

khu tshur kha sbyar gung mo gnyis// brkyangs te rtse sbyar du bzhi'i rgya// khu tshur gyen 'thor me tog gi /thur du blugs par bdug pa'i 'o// mthe bong gyen bsgreng mar me'i ste// thal mo phyir bstan dri mchog gi /de nyid gyen bkan zhal zas so// se gol gtogs pa rol mo'i sgra// zhes pa ltar ro// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
